english.title: Aid / abet dangerous driving

On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to drive a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), dangerously on

english.legislation: Contrary to section 2 of the Road Traffic Act 1988, section 8 of the Accessories and Abettors Act 1861 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See section 2A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 for meaning of dangerous driving.
(ii) See section 13A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 for the disapplication of s.2 for authorised motoring events.
(iii) See section 24 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 for alternative verdicts.
(iv) See Makeham v Donaldson (1981) RTR 511 for circumstances where disqualification is obligatory.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed ten penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
